title: Harmonic Distortion Analysis & IEEE 519-2022 Compliance in Pakistan 2026: THDv, THDi, PCC Limits, WAPDA/DISCO Enforcement & Mitigation Buyer Guide
summary_html: Complete guide to harmonic distortion analysis and IEEE 519-2022 compliance for Pakistani industrial consumers 2026. Covers THDv/THDi measurement methodology (IEC 61000-4-30 Class A), WAPDA PCC voltage harmonic limits, NEPRA Determination 2025 enforcement for >500 kW consumers, VFD harmonic current injection in Faisalabad/Karachi textile mills, generator island-mode harmonic amplification during 12–16 hr/day load-shedding, K-factor transformer selection, active harmonic filter (AHF) sizing, line reactor + AHF combined mitigation, detuned APFC interaction, 12-pulse/18-pulse rectifier options, PKR price guide for all mitigation technologies (line reactors PKR 8,000–110,000, AHF 30A–200A PKR 650,000–3,800,000), IEEE 519-2022 two-point measurement methodology for DISCO dispute attribution, and a worked example (Faisalabad textile mill, 650 kW VFD load, 8.2% THDv reduced to 3.2% with PKR 4.14M mitigation package).
